title: •Gold Leader In Gold 1
caption: •Gold Leader In Gold 1 (V)
game_text: May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot is •Dutch, who provides ability of 2. Opponent may not ‘react’ to here and must first use 1 Force to draw a card for battle destiny here.
lore: At the Battle of Yavin, Dutch led his squadron of outdated but reliable Y-wings in the first wave of the assault against the Death Star.
copyright: TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1996 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Banner STARFIGHTER: Y-WING. Stats POWER 4 / MANEUVER 3 / HYPERSPEED 4; deploy 3 / forfeit 4. Scomp-link ring → scomp true. Icon column top to bottom: pilot helmet (permanent pilot on a starship → permanent-pilot, as vs7/09), red nav computer → nav. Curly single quotes around ‘react’ (stub straight); stub writes '(*) Dutch' for the slip's •Dutch. Lore matches the scan. Expansion per wiki 'Rebel Leader Packs' (Premium; grey ring icon beside the lore). Base scan only at 350 px and its copyright line is illegible; copyright 1996 read off the PC's 745 px V0 remake (which copies the printed top half) — verify if the Rebel Leader pack print differs. Modern: V0-L-goldleaderingold1.gif (745 px, same slip text and stats); VB1-L-goldleaderingold1(-pre).gif (350) also exists, not downloaded.
